# dsh-open-card
可拖拽边框的面板尺寸调节插件 · A drag-to-resize panel add-on for DeepSeek Harness
中文 · English
## 中文
### 这是什么
`dsh-open-card` 是 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的一个客户端插件。它给页面上**任意**界面块加一层可拖拽的边框：点选之后拉边角改长宽，还能整体平移、置前、收起，尺
是 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的一个客户端插件。它给页面上**任意**界面块加一层可拖拽的边框：点选之后拉边角改长宽，还能整体平移、置前、收起，尺寸记在浏览器里，刷新后自动恢复。
### 解决什么问题
第三方插件常常在自己的面板里塞满内容，把会话列表、输入区、工具栏挡住，而用户没法把它的尺寸改小——因为布局宽度由框架内部的 store 独占，插件之间也没有互相调整的公开接口。
这个插件不去猜别人的 DOM 结构，也不依赖任何插件的内部实现：**由用户点选目标块**，插件在改动前快照它原有的内联样式，再用内联样式直接写 `width` / `height` / `transf
orm` / `z-index`。所以它对任何插件、任何面板都生效，并且随时可以一键还原。
### 功能
| 能力 | 说明 |

| 点选块 | 鼠标移上去蓝框高亮，点一下选中；`Alt+R` 进入/退出点选模式 |
| 拖拽改尺寸 | 8 个方向控制点，任意拖长拖宽 |
| 收起 | 把块压成 0 高让出位置，块本身还在，随时

展开 |
| 滚动模式 | 块缩小后内容保持原大小、改为内部滚动，不被压扁截断（缩到 50% 以下自动开启） |
| 上溯一层 | 点选常落在最内层的小 span 上，一键选中包含它的容器 |
| 平

移 | 按住整体拖动，位置也一起记住 |
| 置前 | 提到最前，避免被别的浮层盖住 |
| 复位 | 这一块还原成插件改动前的样子 |
| 记忆 | 尺寸、位置、收起/滚动状态按元素持久化在 `lo

calStorage`，刷新后自动重建 |
| 可拖动悬浮球 | 悬浮球本身位置也可拖动并记忆，拖到边缘自动收进视口 |
### 安装

安装后刷新页面即可；右下角会出现悬浮球。
### 用法

1. 点右下角悬浮球，或按 `Alt+R`。
2. 鼠标移到要调整的块上，蓝框出现后点一下。
3. 拖 8 个控制点改长宽；顶部工具条给出收起、滚动、上溯、复位、置前、移动、取消。
4. `Esc`

### 存储

- `dsh-open-card.sizes.v1` — 每个元素的尺寸/位置/收起/滚动状态，键是元素选择器（锚定最近的 `id` 或 `data-slot`）。
- `dsh-open-card.

dock.v1` — 悬浮球位置。
- 从旧名 `dsh-resizer` 升级时会自动读取旧键，不丢配置。
### 实现说明
`ctx.layout` 只暴露导航与面板选择（`selectPanel` / `toggleSidebar` / `openRightbar` / `closeRightbar`），没有改列宽的入口
——三列宽度由 `AppFrame` 内部 store 独占。因此本插件不触碰框架布局，而是作用于用户选中的具体元素。
同时，`shell.overlay` 自带 `z-index: 20` 的层叠上下文，挂在那里永远压不过鲸鱼挂件一类的高 z-index 浮层；所以整个 UI 用 `ReactDOM.createPo
rtal` 挂到 `document.body`，自己开一层 `z-index: 2147483000`。
### 图标

## English
### What it is
`dsh-open-card` is a client-side plugin for the **DeepSeek Harness** Web UI. It puts a draggable fra
me around *any* panel on the page: click a block, drag its borders to resize it, then move it, raise
it, or collapse it entirely. Sizes are stored in the browser and restored on reload.
### The problem it solves
Third-party plugins often fill their own panel with content that covers your conversation list, comp
oser, or toolbar — and you cannot shrink them, because column widths are owned by an internal layout
store and plugins expose no API to resize one another.
Instead of guessing at other plugins' DOM structure, this plugin lets **you pick the block**. It sna
pshots the block's existing inline style, then writes `width` / `height` / `transform` / `z-index` d
irectly. It therefore works on any panel from any plugin, and every change can be undone with one cl
tly. It therefore works on any panel from any plugin, and every change can be undone with one click.
### Features
| Capability | Description |

| Pick a block | Hovering outlines the block in blue; click to select. `Alt+R` toggles pick mode |
|

Drag to resize | Eight handles — drag any border or corner |
| Collapse | Squash the block to zero

height to free the space it covers; the block stays alive and can be expanded again |
| Scroll mode
| When a block is shrunk, its content keeps its natural size and scrolls internally instead of being

squeezed (auto-enabled below 50%) |
| Select parent | Picking often lands on a tiny inner `span`; j

ump to the containing container in one click |
| Move | Drag the whole block; its offset is remember

ed too |
| Raise | Bring the block to the front so other overlays cannot cover it |
| Reset | Restor

e this block to exactly how it looked before the plugin touched it |
| Persistence | Size, offset, c
ollapsed and scrolling state are persisted per element in `localStorage` and re-applied on reload |
| Draggable launcher | The floating launcher can itself be dragged and remembers its position, and i
s nudged back inside the viewport at the edges |
